title: Adabiy matnlarni tahlil qilish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida badiiy vositalarni nomlab, ularning ta’sirini tushuntira olasiz, mavzu va g‘oyani farqlab, ramzni kontekstda talqin qilasiz, uslubni aniq atamalar bilan tavsiflaysiz va adabiy hozirgi zamonda tezisli, iqtiboslar bilan asoslangan tahliliy xatboshi yozasiz.

scenes.title: Adabiy matn tahlili
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda inversiya va cleft gaplar kabi murakkab tuzilmalarni egalladik. Bugun tilni eng ongli ko‘rinishida, adabiyotda ko‘ramiz. Esda tuting: qayta hikoya qilish “nima bo‘ldi” deydi, tahlil esa “qanday yozilgan va nega”. Dars oxirida badiiy vositalarni ta’siri bilan tushuntirasiz, g‘oya va ramzni talqin qilasiz, uslubni aniq tavsiflaysiz va qisqa tahlil yozasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we mastered inversion and cleft sentences. Today we turn to literature, where every choice is deliberate. A summary tells us what happens; an analysis explains how a text is written and why it matters.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi safar inversiya va cleft gaplarni egalladik. Bugun har bir tanlov ongli bo‘lgan adabiyotga o‘tamiz. Qisqa bayon nima bo‘lishini aytadi, tahlil esa matn qanday yozilgani va nega muhimligini tushuntiradi.

scenes.title: O‘xshatish va metafora
board: Uzbek: o‘xshatish · istiora · tashxis · mubolag‘a · tazod

examples.t: Her silence was as heavy as wet sand.
examples.uz: Uning sukuti ho‘l qumdek og‘ir edi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: badiiy vositalar. Simile, ya’ni o‘xshatish, “like” yoki “as” bilan ochiq taqqoslaydi: “as heavy as wet sand”. Metaphor esa taqqoslash so‘zisiz bir narsani boshqasi deb ataydi: “All the world’s a stage”. Shekspir bu metaforani davom ettiradi: odamlar aktyor, hayot bosqichlari rol. Bunday rivojlangan metafora extended metaphor deyiladi. Bu vositalar o‘zbek mumtoz poetikasidan ham tanish, lekin ingliz tanqidchiligi san’atni tasniflashdan ko‘ra uning ta’siriga ko‘proq qaraydi.
scenes.say: A simile makes the comparison explicit with like or as. A metaphor simply asserts that one thing is another. Sustained across several lines, it becomes an extended metaphor.
scenes.say_uz: O‘xshatish taqqoslashni like yoki as bilan ochiq qiladi. Metafora bir narsa boshqasi ekanini to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri da’vo qiladi. Bir necha satr davomida saqlansa, u kengaytirilgan metaforaga aylanadi.

scenes.title: Jonlantirish va mubolag‘a

examples.t: The old house groaned in the wind.
'Just a scratch,' said the man with the broken leg.

scenes.say_native: Personification jonsiz narsaga inson xususiyatini beradi: uy “ingraydi”. Hyperbole ataylab oshirib aytish, understatement esa aksincha, jiddiy narsani kichraytirish, ko‘pincha hazil yoki kinoya uchun. Pathetic fallacy esa ob-havo qahramon kayfiyatini aks ettirishi, masalan, dafn paytida yomg‘ir yog‘ishi.
scenes.say: Personification lends human qualities to the inanimate. Hyperbole exaggerates; understatement deliberately plays things down. Pathetic fallacy occurs when the weather seems to echo a character's feelings.
scenes.say_uz: Jonlantirish jonsiz narsaga inson sifatini beradi. Mubolag‘a oshirib yuboradi, understatement esa narsani ataylab kichraytiradi. Pathetic fallacy ob-havo qahramon tuyg‘ularini aks ettirganda yuz beradi.

scenes.title: Tovush vositalari
scenes.say_native: Tovush vositalari. Alliteration so‘z boshidagi undosh tovush takrori: “silent, sodden streets”. Assonance yaqin so‘zlarda unli tovush takrori: “the low moan of the road”. Onomatopoeia tovushga taqlid: buzz, hiss. Diqqat: gap harfda emas, tovushda. “Cat” va “kite” alliteratsiya hosil qiladi, “cat” va “city” esa yo‘q.
scenes.say: Alliteration repeats initial consonant sounds, assonance repeats vowel sounds, and onomatopoeia imitates what it names. Think in sounds, not spellings: cat and kite alliterate; cat and city do not.
scenes.say_uz: Alliteratsiya boshlang‘ich undosh tovushlarni, assonans unli tovushlarni takrorlaydi, onomatopeya esa atagan narsasiga taqlid qiladi. Harf emas, tovush haqida o‘ylang: cat va kite alliteratsiya hosil qiladi, cat va city yo‘q.

scenes.title: Ironiya turlari
board: dramatic irony: the audience knows more
scenes.say_native: Ironiya, ya’ni kinoya, uch xil. Verbal irony: aytilgan so‘z ko‘zlanganning teskarisi, masalan, bo‘ronda “qanday ajoyib havo!” deyish. Situational irony: natija kutilganning aksi. Dramatic irony: tomoshabin qahramon bilmagan narsani biladi. “Romeo va Juletta”da biz Juletta tirikligini bilamiz, Romeo esa bilmaydi.
scenes.say: Verbal irony says the opposite of what is meant. Situational irony reverses our expectations. Dramatic irony depends on the audience knowing more than the character, as when we know Juliet is alive and Romeo does not.
scenes.say_uz: Og‘zaki ironiya ko‘zlanganning teskarisini aytadi. Vaziyat ironiyasi kutganimizni teskari qiladi. Dramatik ironiya tomoshabin qahramondan ko‘proq bilishiga tayanadi: biz Juletta tirikligini bilamiz, Romeo esa bilmaydi.

scenes.title: Tuzilma vositalari

examples.t: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times. (Dickens)
examples.uz: Bu eng yaxshi zamonlar edi, bu eng yomon zamonlar edi. (Dikkens)

scenes.say_native: Tuzilma vositalari. Juxtaposition qarama-qarshi narsalarni yonma-yon qo‘yish, antithesis esa buni parallel grammatika bilan qiladi, xuddi Dikkensdagidek. U yerda anaphora ham bor: “it was” takrori. Enjambment she’rda gapning keyingi satrga oqib o‘tishi, foreshadowing kelajakka ishora, oxymoron esa zid so‘zlarning birikishi: “faithful liar”.
scenes.say: Antithesis balances opposites in parallel grammar; anaphora repeats words at the start of successive clauses. Enjambment carries a sentence past the line break, foreshadowing hints at what is to come, and an oxymoron fuses contradictory terms.
scenes.say_uz: Antiteza qarama-qarshiliklarni parallel grammatikada muvozanatlaydi, anafora ketma-ket bo‘laklar boshida so‘zni takrorlaydi. Enjambment gapni satrdan o‘tkazadi, foreshadowing kelajakka ishora qiladi, oksimoron esa zid so‘zlarni birlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy parcha
board: Listen: how many devices can you spot?
blanket of fog · silent, sodden streets
faithful old liar · held its breath
scenes.say_native: Endi men yozgan qisqa parchani tinglang. Unda kamida beshta vosita bor: metafora, alliteratsiya, jonlantirish, oksimoron va mubolag‘a. Har birini topganingizda uning ta’sirini ham o‘ylang. Masalan, “blanket of fog”: ko‘rpa iliqlik beradi, lekin ostidagini yashiradi ham. Demak, shahar nimanidir yashirmoqda.
scenes.say: The town slept beneath a blanket of fog, its silent, sodden streets empty of everything but rumour. Somewhere a dog barked, once, twice, then thought better of it. The church clock, that faithful old liar, struck nine at a quarter past eight. And Mrs Hale, who had not smiled since the war, smiled now, and the whole street held its breath.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar tuman ko‘rpasi ostida uxlardi, uning jimjit, jiqqa ho‘l ko‘chalarida mish-mishdan boshqa hech narsa yo‘q edi. Qayerdadir it bir, ikki marta hurdi, keyin bu fikridan qaytdi. Cherkov soati, o‘sha sodiq qari yolg‘onchi, sakkizdan o‘n besh daqiqa o‘tganda to‘qqizga bong urdi. Urushdan beri jilmaymagan Hale xonim endi jilmaydi va butun ko‘cha nafasini ichiga yutdi.

scenes.title: Vositani sanash xatosi
board: ✗ There is a metaphor in line 1.
✓ The metaphor of a blanket of fog suggests the town is hiding something.
✓ The alliteration creates a hushed, secretive mood.
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: vositani topib, to‘xtab qolish. “There is a metaphor in line one” bu ro‘yxat, tahlil emas, baholovchi bunga deyarli ball bermaydi. Har doim davom ettiring: bu vosita nimani suggest qiladi, qanday kayfiyat yaratadi? Qoida: vosita nomi gapning boshida bo‘lsa, qolgan qismi uning ta’siri haqida bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Device-spotting is not analysis. Naming a metaphor earns little unless you explain what it suggests and how it shapes the reader's response.
scenes.say_uz: Vositani topib qo‘yish tahlil emas. Metafora nimani anglatishi va o‘quvchiga qanday ta’sir qilishini tushuntirmasangiz, uni nomlash kam narsa beradi.

scenes.title: Vositani toping
board: 2 The wind whispered through the willows.
3 I've told you a million times.
4 The fire station burned to the ground.
scenes.say_native: Navbat sizga. To‘rtta gapni tinglang va har birida asosiy vositani nomlang, ikkinchi gapda esa ikkita vosita bor. Faqat nom bilan cheklanmang: har biri uchun bir og‘iz ta’sirini ham ayting, masalan, “bu so‘zlarning og‘riq berishini kuchaytiradi”. Pauza oling va javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: Her words were daggers. Two: The wind whispered through the willows. Three: I've told you a million times. Four: The fire station burned to the ground.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Uning so‘zlari xanjar edi. Ikki: Shamol majnuntollar orasidan shivirladi. Uch: Senga million marta aytdim. To‘rt: O‘t o‘chirish bo‘limi yonib kul bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: metafora, so‘zlar xanjardek yaralaydi. Ikkinchi: jonlantirish, chunki shamol shivirlaydi, va “w” tovushi bilan alliteratsiya, u mayin, sirli ovoz beradi. Uchinchi: mubolag‘a, u so‘zlovchining jahlini bildiradi. To‘rtinchi: vaziyat ironiyasi, chunki olovga qarshi turishi kerak bo‘lgan binoni olov yo‘q qildi.
scenes.say: One is a metaphor. Two combines personification with alliteration, creating a soft, secretive sound. Three is hyperbole, conveying exasperation. Four is situational irony.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi metafora. Ikkinchisi jonlantirish va alliteratsiyani birlashtirib, mayin, sirli tovush yaratadi. Uchinchisi mubolag‘a, achchiqlanishni bildiradi. To‘rtinchisi vaziyat ironiyasi.

scenes.title: Mavzu, g‘oya, syujet
board: theme: what the text says about it (g‘oya)
The text explores how... / interrogates the idea that...

examples.t: Theme: Unchecked ambition destroys what it seeks to win.
examples.uz: G‘oya: jilovsiz shuhratparastlik o‘zi intilgan narsani yo‘q qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: theme va symbolism. O‘zbekcha “mavzu” ko‘pincha ikkala ma’noni qamraydi, shuning uchun chalkashlik ko‘p. Topic bitta tushuncha: shuhratparastlik. Theme esa asarning shu haqdagi fikri, ya’ni g‘oya, va u to‘liq gap bo‘ladi. Plot esa syujet. Foydali qoliplar: “The text explores how…”, “The novel interrogates the idea that…”.
scenes.say: A topic is a single idea, such as ambition. A theme is the insight a text offers about it, stated as a full sentence. Literature rarely preaches, so phrase themes as nuanced claims, not morals.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu shuhratparastlik kabi bitta tushuncha. G‘oya esa matnning u haqdagi qarashi bo‘lib, to‘liq gap bilan ifodalanadi. Adabiyot kamdan-kam va’z qiladi, shuning uchun g‘oyani nasihat emas, nozik da’vo sifatida ayting.

scenes.title: Ramz, motiv, allegoriya
board: symbol: an object standing for an idea (ramz)
motif: a recurring image or idea
allegory: a whole story with a second meaning

examples.t: the green light in The Great Gatsby

scenes.say_native: Symbol, ya’ni ramz, mavhum g‘oyani ifodalovchi aniq narsa: “Buyuk Getsbi”dagi yashil chiroq Getsbining yetib bo‘lmas orzusini anglatadi. Motif asar davomida qayta-qayta keladigan obraz. Allegory esa butun hikoyaning ikkinchi ma’nosi: Oruellning “Hayvonlar fermasi” rus inqilobi va undan keyingi davr haqidagi allegoriya.
scenes.say: A symbol is a concrete object charged with abstract meaning. A motif recurs and gathers significance through repetition. An allegory sustains a second meaning across an entire narrative, as Animal Farm does.
scenes.say_uz: Ramz mavhum ma’no yuklangan aniq narsa. Motiv takrorlanib, ahamiyat orttiradi. Allegoriya esa butun hikoya bo‘ylab ikkinchi ma’noni saqlaydi, xuddi “Hayvonlar fermasi” kabi.

scenes.title: Ramzli parcha
board: Listen: what might the tree symbolise?
scenes.say_native: Qisqa parchani tinglang. Unda bir narsa ramz vazifasini bajaradi. O‘zingizga ikki savol bering: bu narsa nimani anglatishi mumkin va matn g‘oyasini bitta to‘liq gap bilan qanday aytish mumkin? Bu oila xotirasi haqidagi, bizga juda yaqin manzara. Ko‘p o‘zbek xonadonlarida ham hovlidagi bitta daraxt butun avlodni eslatib turadi.
scenes.say: Every spring my grandmother watered the pomegranate tree her husband had planted. She spoke to it, scolded it, praised it. The year she died, it did not flower. The following spring my mother took the old tin can from the shed and began to water it, and in June it was red again.
scenes.say_uz: Har bahor buvim bobom ekkan anor daraxtini sug‘orardi. U daraxt bilan gaplashar, uni urishar, maqtardi. U vafot etgan yili daraxt gullamadi. Keyingi bahor onam ombordan eski tunuka idishni olib, uni sug‘ora boshladi va iyunda daraxt yana qip-qizil bo‘ldi.

scenes.title: Ramzni talqin qilish
board: The tree may be read as a symbol of...
the tin can → a quiet motif of continuity
scenes.say_native: Talqin: anor daraxtini oiladagi mehr va xotira ramzi sifatida o‘qish mumkin. Buvi vafot etganda daraxt gullamaydi, bu motam. Ona g‘amxo‘rlikni davom ettirganda u yana gullaydi. Eski tunuka idish esa davomiylik belgisi. E’tibor bering, men “may be read as” dedim: ramzni talqin qilishda ehtiyotkorlik C2 belgisi.
scenes.say: The tree may be read as a symbol of love that endures only through care. Its failure to flower mirrors the family's grief, and its renewal suggests that memory survives when it is handed on.
scenes.say_uz: Daraxtni faqat g‘amxo‘rlik orqali yashaydigan mehr ramzi sifatida o‘qish mumkin. Uning gullamasligi oila qayg‘usini aks ettiradi, yangilanishi esa xotira boshqalarga topshirilsa yashab qolishini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: G‘oya va ramzdagi xatolar
board: ✓ The text explores how love endures through care.
✓ Here, red suggests renewal rather than danger.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: g‘oyani bitta so‘z bilan aytish. “The theme is love” bu mavzu, g‘oya emas. Ikkinchisi: ramzni lug‘atdagidek qat’iy deb bilish. Qizil rang har doim xavf emas, bizning parchada u yangilanishni bildiradi. Ramz ma’nosi kontekstdan chiqadi, va dalilsiz har bir tafsilotdan ramz izlash ham zaif tahlil.
scenes.say: A single word is a topic, not a theme. And symbols are not dictionary entries: their meaning is generated by context. Over-reading every detail is as weak as missing the symbol altogether.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta so‘z mavzu, g‘oya emas. Ramzlar lug‘at maqolalari emas, ularning ma’nosini kontekst yaratadi. Har bir tafsilotni ortiqcha talqin qilish ramzni umuman ko‘rmaslik kabi zaif.

scenes.title: Mavzumi, g‘oyami?
board: 2 'A soldier returns home and finds his village gone.'
3 'War leaves wounds that peace cannot heal.'
4 A locked door recurs in six chapters.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Birinchi uchtasida aniqlang: bu mavzumi, g‘oyami yoki syujetmi? To‘rtinchisida: olti bobda takrorlanadigan qulflangan eshik ramzmi, motivmi yoki allegoriyami? Javobni inglizcha boshlang: “This is a theme because…” Esda tuting: g‘oya doim to‘liq gap bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Topic, theme or plot? One: Isolation. Two: A soldier returns home and finds his village gone. Three: War leaves wounds that peace cannot heal. Four: A locked door recurs in six chapters. Symbol, motif or allegory?
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu, g‘oya yoki syujet? Bir: Yolg‘izlik. Ikki: Askar uyiga qaytib, qishlog‘i yo‘qligini ko‘radi. Uch: Urush tinchlik davolay olmaydigan yaralar qoldiradi. To‘rt: Qulflangan eshik olti bobda takrorlanadi. Ramz, motiv yoki allegoriya?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4 motif (it may also carry symbolic weight)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: mavzu, chunki bu bitta mavhum ot. Ikkinchi: syujet, bu faqat voqea. Uchinchi: g‘oya, chunki u urush haqida to‘liq da’vo. To‘rtinchi: motiv, chunki obraz takrorlanadi. Albatta, takrorlanayotgan eshik yashirin sir ramzi ham bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin takrorlanish uning motiv ekanini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Isolation is a topic; the soldier's return is plot; the claim about war is a theme. The recurring locked door is a motif, although a motif may of course carry symbolic weight.
scenes.say_uz: Yolg‘izlik mavzu, askarning qaytishi syujet, urush haqidagi da’vo esa g‘oya. Takrorlanadigan qulflangan eshik motiv, garchi motiv ramziy yuk ham ko‘tarishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Ohang va kayfiyat
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: uslub tahlili lug‘ati. Tone muallif yoki hikoyachining munosabati, mood esa o‘quvchidagi his. “Sad” o‘rniga aniqroq so‘z tanlang: wry, ya’ni yengil kinoyali; elegiac, ya’ni yo‘qotish haqida mungli; sardonic, ya’ni achchiq masxaraomuz; detached, ya’ni sovuq, befarq; ominous, ya’ni yomonlikdan darak beruvchi.
scenes.say: Tone is the writer's attitude; mood is the atmosphere the reader experiences. Replace vague words like sad with precise ones: elegiac, wry, sardonic, detached or ominous.
scenes.say_uz: Ohang muallifning munosabati, kayfiyat esa o‘quvchi his qiladigan muhit. Sad kabi noaniq so‘zlarni aniqlari bilan almashtiring: elegiac, wry, sardonic, detached yoki ominous.

scenes.title: So‘z tanlovi: diction
board: diction: colloquial · formal · archaic · terse · clinical
scenes.say_native: Diction, ya’ni so‘z tanlovi, colloquial, formal, archaic, terse yoki clinical, ya’ni tibbiy hisobotdek hissiz bo‘lishi mumkin. Denotation so‘zning lug‘aviy ma’nosi, connotation esa unga yopishgan his. “Home”, “residence”, “dwelling” bir narsani bildiradi, ammo konnotatsiyasi boshqa, xuddi o‘zbekcha “uy”, “qarorgoh”, “maskan” kabi.
scenes.say: Words may share a denotation yet differ in connotation: home is warm, residence official, dwelling archaic. Always ask why the writer chose this word rather than its near synonym.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zlar bir lug‘aviy ma’noga ega bo‘lib, konnotatsiyada farq qilishi mumkin: home iliq, residence rasmiy, dwelling eskicha. Muallif nega aynan shu so‘zni tanlaganini doim so‘rang.

scenes.title: Gap tuzilishi: syntax
scenes.say_native: Syntax ham ma’no tashiydi. Qisqa, uzuq gaplar keskinlik beradi: “He ran. Stopped. Listened.” Periodic sentence asosiy fikrni oxirigacha kechiktirib, intizorlik yaratadi. Parataxis bo‘laklarni “and” bilan teng qo‘shadi, hypotaxis esa “although”, “which” bilan tobe qilib, mulohazakor ongni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Clipped fragments create tension. A periodic sentence withholds its main clause until the end. Parataxis strings clauses together with and, while hypotaxis subordinates them, suggesting a more reflective mind.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa uzuq gaplar keskinlik yaratadi. Periodik gap asosiy bo‘lakni oxirigacha ushlaydi. Parataksis bo‘laklarni and bilan bog‘laydi, gipotaksis esa ularni tobe qilib, mulohazakorroq ongni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Tahlil fe’llari

examples.t: The imagery evokes a world in decline.
The cheerful rhyme undercuts the grim subject.

scenes.say_native: “Shows” o‘rniga aniq fe’llar ishlating. Suggests va implies bilvosita ishora qiladi, evokes his uyg‘otadi, conveys ma’no yetkazadi, underscores va foregrounds birinchi o‘ringa chiqaradi. Undercuts ichidan kuchsizlantiradi, subverts esa kutilgan qolipni ag‘daradi. Bu fe’llar tahlilni darhol professional qiladi.
scenes.say: Replace shows with verbs that specify the relationship. Imagery evokes, diction connotes, structure foregrounds, and a cheerful rhythm may undercut a grim subject.
scenes.say_uz: Shows o‘rniga munosabatni aniqlovchi fe’llarni qo‘ying. Obraz uyg‘otadi, so‘z tanlovi konnotatsiya beradi, tuzilma oldinga chiqaradi, quvnoq ritm esa ma’yus mavzuni kuchsizlantirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha qoliplardan xatolar
board: ✗ The author wants to say that...
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. “Muallif aytmoqchiki” iborasini “The author wants to say” deb tarjima qilish ingliz tanqidida sodda eshitiladi, chunki biz niyatni bilmaymiz. “The text suggests” deng. Ikkinchisi: “describes about”, “discusses about”. Describe va discuss o‘timli fe’l, “about” olmaydi.
scenes.say: Avoid guessing at intention with the author wants to say; discuss the text's effect instead. And describe and discuss are transitive: we describe loss and discuss a theme.
scenes.say_uz: The author wants to say bilan niyatni taxmin qilmang, matn ta’siri haqida gapiring. Describe va discuss o‘timli: describe loss va discuss a theme deymiz.

scenes.title: Aniq so‘zni tanlang
board: 1 The cheerful rhythm ___ the grim subject. (shows / undercuts)
2 A mournful tone about loss is ___. (sad / elegiac)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap, har birida ikki variant. To‘g‘risini tanlab, nega to‘g‘riligini ayting. C2 darajasida ba’zan ikkala variant ham grammatik bo‘ladi, lekin biri aniqroq va professionalroq. Uchinchi gapda denotatsiya va konnotatsiya farqini, to‘rtinchisida esa fe’lning o‘timliligini eslang. Pauza.
scenes.say: One: The cheerful rhythm shows, or undercuts, the grim subject. Two: A mournful tone about loss is sad, or elegiac. Three: Dwelling has an archaic denotation, or connotation. Four: The poem describes, or describes about, loss.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Quvnoq ritm ma’yus mavzuni ko‘rsatadi yoki kuchsizlantiradi. Ikki: Yo‘qotish haqidagi mungli ohang g‘amgin yoki marsiyaviy. Uch: Dwelling eskicha lug‘aviy ma’no yoki konnotatsiyaga ega. To‘rt: She’r yo‘qotishni tasvirlaydi yoki haqida tasvirlaydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: undercuts, chunki ritm mavzuga qarshi ishlaydi, “shows” bu munosabatni bildirmaydi. Ikkinchi: elegiac, u yo‘qotish haqidagi mungli mulohazani aniq ifodalaydi. Uchinchi: connotation, chunki eskicha tus lug‘aviy ma’no emas, qo‘shimcha his. To‘rtinchi: “describes loss”, “about” siz.
scenes.say: Undercuts, because the rhythm works against the subject. Elegiac, as it captures mournful reflection. Connotation, since the archaic flavour is an association. And describes takes a direct object.
scenes.say_uz: Undercuts, chunki ritm mavzuga qarshi ishlaydi. Elegiac, chunki u mungli mulohazani ifodalaydi. Connotation, chunki eskicha tus assotsiatsiya. Describes esa to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchi oladi.

scenes.title: Adabiy hozirgi zamon
board: ✗ Hamlet hesitated because he was afraid.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqtaga o‘tishdan oldin muhim qoida: literary present. Asar ichidagi voqealar hozirgi zamonda tahlil qilinadi, chunki matn har o‘qilganda qayta “sodir bo‘ladi”: “Hamlet hesitates”, “the narrator reveals”. O‘zbekchada ko‘pincha o‘tgan zamon ishlatilgani uchun bu xato juda ko‘p. Tarixiy fakt esa o‘tgan zamonda qoladi: “Shakespeare wrote Hamlet around 1600”.
scenes.say: In literary analysis, use the present tense for events and techniques within the text: Hamlet hesitates, the poem ends with a question. Keep the past for historical facts about the writer.
scenes.say_uz: Adabiy tahlilda matn ichidagi voqea va usullar uchun hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi: Hamlet ikkilanadi, she’r savol bilan tugaydi. O‘tgan zamon muallif haqidagi tarixiy faktlar uchun qoladi.

scenes.title: Tahlil tuzilmasi
board: Embed short quotations in your own sentence
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: tahlil yozish. Kirishda asar va muallifni nomlab, tezisni aytasiz. Har xatboshi to‘rt qadam: Point, Evidence, ya’ni qisqa iqtibos, Analysis, ya’ni so‘z darajasidagi tahlil, va Link, ya’ni tezisga qaytish. Iqtibosni o‘z gapingizga singdiring: “The narrator’s ‘faithful old liar’ blends affection with mockery”. Xulosada matnni qayta aytmay, uning ahamiyatini ko‘rsating.
scenes.say: Open with a clear thesis. Each paragraph makes a point, embeds brief quotation, analyses the language closely and links back. A quotation never speaks for itself: your analysis must do the talking.
scenes.say_uz: Aniq tezis bilan boshlang. Har bir xatboshi fikr bildiradi, qisqa iqtibosni singdiradi, tilni sinchiklab tahlil qiladi va tezisga qaytadi. Iqtibos o‘zicha gapirmaydi, gapirish tahlilingiz vazifasi.

scenes.title: Kuchli tezis
board: ✗ This poem is about a tree. (fact)
✓ Through the motif of the tree, the text presents grief as a form of inheritance.
scenes.say_native: Tezis fakt emas, chunki fakt bilan bahslashib bo‘lmaydi: “This poem is about a tree”. Shunchaki baho ham emas: “very beautiful”. Yaxshi tezis bahsli, aniq va “qanday” degan savolga javob beradi: “Through the motif of the tree, the text presents grief as a form of inheritance”. Unda vosita ham, g‘oya ham bor va boshqa o‘quvchi unga e’tiroz bildira oladi.
scenes.say: A strong thesis is arguable, specific and concerned with how meaning is made. It names a technique, links it to an idea and offers a reading that another reader could reasonably contest.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli tezis bahsli, aniq va ma’no qanday yaratilishiga qaratilgan. U usulni nomlaydi, uni g‘oyaga bog‘laydi va boshqa o‘quvchi asosli e’tiroz bildira oladigan talqinni beradi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy xatboshi
board: Model paragraph on the fog passage
scenes.say_native: Endi tuman haqidagi parcha bo‘yicha namunaviy xatboshini tinglang. To‘rt qadamni kuzating: fikr, qisqa iqtibos, so‘z darajasidagi tahlil va tezisga qaytish. Fe’llarga ham e’tibor bering: evokes, suggests, confirms. Zamon esa doim hozirgi. Natijada xatboshi voqeani qayta aytmaydi, balki bitta aniq talqinni isbotlaydi.
scenes.say: From its opening image, the passage presents the town as a place of concealment. The metaphor of a blanket of fog evokes comfort, yet a blanket also hides what lies beneath it. The sibilant hush of silent, sodden streets suggests that the town is not peaceful but secretive. When the whole street holds its breath, the hyperbole confirms that here, private feeling instantly becomes public spectacle.
scenes.say_uz: Parcha birinchi obrazidanoq shaharni yashirish maskani sifatida tasvirlaydi. Tuman ko‘rpasi metaforasi qulaylikni yodga soladi, biroq ko‘rpa ostidagini yashiradi ham. Silent, sodden streets dagi shivirlovchi sukunat shahar osoyishta emas, sirli ekanini ko‘rsatadi. Butun ko‘cha nafasini yutganda mubolag‘a bu yerda shaxsiy tuyg‘u darhol ommaviy tomoshaga aylanishini tasdiqlaydi.

scenes.title: Qayta hikoya qilish xatosi
board: ✗ First the dog barks, then the clock strikes, then Mrs Hale smiles.
✓ The sequence moves from sound to silence, building suspense.
Test: does every sentence answer HOW or WHY?
scenes.say_native: Juda ko‘p uchraydigan xato: tahlil o‘rniga syujetni qayta aytish. “Avval it huradi, keyin soat chalinadi” bu faqat voqea. To‘g‘ri yo‘l: ketma-ketlik nima qilayotganini aytish, masalan, u tovushdan sukunatga o‘tib, intizorlikni kuchaytiradi. Sinov: har bir gapingiz “qanday” yoki “nega” savoliga javob beryaptimi?
scenes.say: Retelling the plot is the commonest reason analytical essays lose marks. If a sentence only tells me what happens, rewrite it to comment on the effect of the writer's choices.
scenes.say_uz: Syujetni qayta aytish tahliliy esselar ball yo‘qotishining eng ko‘p sababi. Agar gap faqat nima bo‘lishini aytsa, uni muallif tanlovlarining ta’siri haqida qilib qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Tahlilga aylantiring
board: 1 The grandmother died and the tree did not flower.
2 The writer used short sentences at the end.
3 There is a simile in line 4 (the house is like a ship).
scenes.say_native: Uchta zaif gapni kuchli tahliliy gapga aylantiring. Birinchisi faqat syujet, ikkinchisida o‘tgan zamon va noaniq “used”, uchinchisida vosita bor, ta’sir yo‘q. Hozirgi zamon, aniq fe’l va ta’sirni ishlating. Javobni yozib qo‘ysangiz, namuna bilan solishtirish oson bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Turn three weak sentences into analysis. One: The grandmother died and the tree did not flower. Two: The writer used short sentences at the end. Three: There is a simile in line four, comparing the house to a ship.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta zaif gapni tahlilga aylantiring. Bir: Buvi vafot etdi va daraxt gullamadi. Ikki: Muallif oxirida qisqa gaplar ishlatdi. Uch: To‘rtinchi satrda uyni kemaga qiyoslovchi o‘xshatish bor.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1 The tree's failure to flower mirrors the family's grief.
2 The clipped final sentences heighten the sense of finality.
3 Likening the house to a ship suggests fragility and isolation.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar. Birinchi: “mirrors” fe’li tafsilot va tuyg‘u o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni ko‘rsatadi. Ikkinchi: zamon hozirgi, “clipped” aniq sifat, “heighten the sense of finality” esa ta’sir. Uchinchi: o‘xshatishni tilga olib, darhol “suggests” bilan ma’nosiga o‘tamiz. Sizning so‘zlaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tuzilma.
scenes.say: The tree's failure to flower mirrors the family's grief. The clipped final sentences heighten the sense of finality. Likening the house to a ship suggests fragility and isolation.
scenes.say_uz: Daraxtning gullamasligi oila qayg‘usini aks ettiradi. Qisqa yakuniy gaplar intiho tuyg‘usini kuchaytiradi. Uyni kemaga qiyoslash mo‘rtlik va yolg‘izlikni anglatadi.

scenes.title: Dialog: seminar
board: The final stanza of a poem about a swing
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Seminarda o‘qituvchi va ikki talaba bolalar arg‘imchog‘i haqidagi she’rning so‘nggi bandini muhokama qiladi. Quloq soling: Amira qanday da’vo qiladi, Ben nega qisman qo‘shilmaydi va qaysi shakl vositasi tilga olinadi. Ularning muloyim bahslashish uslubiga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Tutor: So, how do you read the final stanza? Amira: I'd argue that the image of the empty swing undercuts the cheerful tone of the opening. Ben: I'm not sure I'd go that far. The swing is still moving, which implies the child has only just left. It's ambiguous rather than bleak. Tutor: So the ending resists closure. And the form? Amira: The enjambment in the last two lines seems to mimic the swing's motion.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Xo‘sh, so‘nggi bandni qanday talqin qilasiz? Amira: Menimcha, bo‘sh arg‘imchoq obrazi boshidagi quvnoq ohangni kuchsizlantiradi. Ben: Men bunchalik uzoqqa bormasdim. Arg‘imchoq hali tebranyapti, demak bola endigina ketgan. Bu ma’yuslik emas, ikki ma’nolilik. O‘qituvchi: Demak, yakun aniq nuqta qo‘ymaydi. Shakl-chi? Amira: Oxirgi ikki satrdagi enjambment arg‘imchoq harakatiga taqlid qilganga o‘xshaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 What effect does Amira attribute to the empty swing?
3 Which formal device is linked to motion?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: Amira bo‘sh arg‘imchoqqa qanday ta’sirni bog‘laydi? Ikkinchi: Ben nega qisman qo‘shilmaydi va qaysi dalilga tayanadi? Uchinchi: qaysi shakl vositasi harakat bilan bog‘lanadi? Inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Mazmun muhim, so‘zma-so‘z takrorlash shart emas.
scenes.say: One: What effect does Amira attribute to the empty swing? Two: Why does Ben partly disagree? Three: Which formal device is linked to motion?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Amira bo‘sh arg‘imchoqqa qanday ta’sirni bog‘laydi? Ikki: Ben nega qisman qo‘shilmaydi? Uch: Qaysi shakl vositasi harakat bilan bog‘lanadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2 The swing is still moving → ambiguous, not bleak
I'm not sure I'd go that far. (muloyim e’tiroz)
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Amira fikricha, bo‘sh arg‘imchoq boshidagi quvnoq ohangni kuchsizlantiradi. Ikkinchi: Ben qisman qo‘shilmaydi, chunki arg‘imchoq hali tebranmoqda, demak yakun ma’yus emas, ikki ma’noli. Uchinchi: enjambment. Benning “I’m not sure I’d go that far” iborasi muloyim e’tirozning ajoyib namunasi.
scenes.say: Amira claims the empty swing undercuts the cheerful opening. Ben qualifies this: the swing is still moving, so the ending is ambiguous rather than bleak. The formal device is enjambment.
scenes.say_uz: Amira bo‘sh arg‘imchoq quvnoq boshlanishni kuchsizlantiradi deydi. Ben buni aniqlashtiradi: arg‘imchoq hali tebranyapti, demak yakun ma’yus emas, ikki ma’noli. Shakl vositasi enjambment.

scenes.title: Dialog: radio intervyu
board: An unreliable narrator in a new novel
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Radio boshlovchisi tanqidchidan yangi roman haqida so‘raydi, uning hikoyachisi ishonchsiz deb hisoblanadi. E’tibor bering: tanqidchi buni qanday isbotlaydi, bu kamchilikmi va proza uslubi qanday rol o‘ynaydi. Tanqidchining aniq iboralarini eslab qolishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Host: Your review calls the narrator unreliable. Why? Critic: He insists he's indifferent to his brother's success, yet he mentions it on almost every page. The gap between what he claims and what he reveals is where the irony lives. Host: Isn't that a flaw? Critic: Quite the opposite. And the terse, clipped prose makes his denials sound rehearsed, as if he's been practising them for years.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Taqrizingizda hikoyachini ishonchsiz deb ataysiz. Nega? Tanqidchi: U akasining muvaffaqiyatiga befarqman deydi, ammo deyarli har sahifada uni tilga oladi. U da’vo qilgan va oshkor qilgan narsa orasidagi tafovut ironiyaning makoni. Boshlovchi: Bu kamchilik emasmi? Tanqidchi: Aksincha. Qisqa, uzuq proza esa uning inkorlarini yod olingandek eshittiradi, go‘yo u ularni yillab mashq qilgan.

scenes.title: Intervyu bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 What evidence shows the narrator is unreliable?
2 Does the critic see this as a flaw?
3 How does the prose style contribute?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: hikoyachining ishonchsizligini qaysi dalil ko‘rsatadi? Ikkinchi: tanqidchi buni kamchilik deb biladimi? Uchinchi: proza uslubi qanday hissa qo‘shadi? Javobda “terse” va “clipped” so‘zlarini ishlating. Esdan chiqqan bo‘lsa, dialog mazmunini qisqacha tiklab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: One: What evidence shows the narrator is unreliable? Two: Does the critic see this as a flaw? Three: How does the prose style contribute?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Hikoyachi ishonchsiz ekanini qaysi dalil ko‘rsatadi? Ikki: Tanqidchi buni kamchilik deb biladimi? Uch: Proza uslubi qanday hissa qo‘shadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Claims indifference, yet mentions his brother's success constantly
3 Terse, clipped prose → denials sound rehearsed
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: hikoyachi befarqman deydi, lekin deyarli har sahifada akasining muvaffaqiyati haqida gapiradi, ya’ni da’vo va haqiqat orasida tafovut bor. Ikkinchi: yo‘q, “Quite the opposite”, bu romanning kuchli tomoni. Uchinchi: qisqa, uzuq proza inkorlarni oldindan tayyorlangandek ko‘rsatadi. “Where the irony lives” iborasini ham tahlilda ishlating.
scenes.say: He claims indifference yet mentions his brother's success constantly. The critic sees this as a strength, not a flaw. The terse, clipped prose makes his denials sound rehearsed, deepening the irony.
scenes.say_uz: U befarqlikni da’vo qiladi, ammo akasining muvaffaqiyatini doim tilga oladi. Tanqidchi buni kamchilik emas, kuchli tomon deb biladi. Qisqa, uzuq proza inkorlarni yod olingandek eshittirib, ironiyani chuqurlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u ko‘chishi
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Bu atamalarda so‘z shakli o‘zgarganda urg‘u ko‘chadi: METaphor, lekin metaPHORical; IRony, lekin iRONic; SYMbol, lekin symBOLic. Hyperbole ni ko‘pchilik “hayper-boul” deydi, aslida to‘rt bo‘g‘in, urg‘u ikkinchisida: hy-PER-bo-le. “A sense of” kabi birikmalarda “a” va “of” kuchsiz shaklda, oldingi so‘zga ulanib aytiladi.
scenes.say: Listen to the stress shift: metaphor, metaphorical; irony, ironic; symbol, symbolic. Hyperbole has four syllables, stressed on the second. And the weak forms link smoothly: a sense of foreboding.
scenes.say_uz: Urg‘u ko‘chishini tinglang: metaphor, metaphorical; irony, ironic; symbol, symbolic. Hyperbole to‘rt bo‘g‘inli, urg‘u ikkinchisida. Kuchsiz shakllar esa ravon ulanadi: a sense of foreboding.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq
board: Analyse in 5 sentences: thesis · quotation · device · effect · link
The kitchen was immaculate. Every cup faced the same way.
On the table, a single letter lay unopened, as it had for three days.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Parcha bo‘yicha besh gapli tahliliy xatboshi yozing yoki ayting: tezis, iqtibos, vosita, ta’sir va tezisga qaytish. Hozirgi zamon va kamida ikkita aniq fe’l ishlating. O‘ylang: oshxonadagi tartib nimani yashirishi mumkin, xat nimaning ramzi?
scenes.say: Final task. Analyse this passage in five sentences. The kitchen was immaculate. Every cup faced the same way. On the table, a single letter lay unopened, as it had for three days.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Bu parchani besh gapda tahlil qiling. Oshxona benuqson toza edi. Har bir piyola bir tomonga qaragan edi. Stolda bitta xat ochilmay yotardi, uch kundan beri shunday.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Thesis: order as a defence against emotion
unopened letter → a symbol of avoided truth
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang va o‘zingiznikiga solishtiring. Tezis: tartib his-tuyg‘udan himoya. “Immaculate” va “every cup faced the same way” haddan tashqari nazoratni ko‘rsatadi. Xat qochilayotgan haqiqat ramzi sifatida talqin qilinadi va oxirida tezisga qaytiladi. Javobingizda tezis, iqtibos, ta’sir va hozirgi zamon bo‘lsa, ajoyib ish qildingiz.
scenes.say: The passage presents order as a defence against emotion. The adjective immaculate and the detail that every cup faced the same way suggest obsessive control. Against this sterile neatness, the unopened letter stands out as a symbol of a truth being avoided. Its three days of neglect imply dread rather than indifference.
scenes.say_uz: Parcha tartibni tuyg‘udan himoya sifatida taqdim etadi. Immaculate sifati va har bir piyola bir tomonga qaragani haddan tashqari nazoratni anglatadi. Bu sovuq ozodalik fonida ochilmagan xat qochilayotgan haqiqat ramzi sifatida ajralib turadi. Uning uch kun e’tiborsiz yotishi befarqlik emas, qo‘rquvni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: Style: tone, diction, syntax + precise verbs
scenes.say_native: Jamlaymiz. Birinchi: vositani nomlash yetarli emas, ta’sirini tushuntiring. Ikkinchi: g‘oya to‘liq da’vo, ramz ma’nosi esa kontekstdan chiqadi. Uchinchi: uslubni tone, diction va syntax orqali aniq so‘zlar bilan tavsiflang. To‘rtinchi: tahlil bahsli tezisdan boshlanadi, har xatboshi fikr, dalil, tahlil va bog‘lanishdan iborat va hozirgi zamonda yoziladi.
scenes.say: To recap: link every device to its effect, state themes as claims, read symbols in context, describe style precisely and build your analysis around an arguable thesis in the literary present.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: har bir vositani ta’siriga bog‘lang, g‘oyani da’vo sifatida ayting, ramzni kontekstda o‘qing, uslubni aniq tavsiflang va tahlilni adabiy hozirgi zamondagi bahsli tezis atrofida quring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: a 200-word analysis of a short literary passage
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan qisqa adabiy parcha bo‘yicha ikki yuz so‘zlik tahlil yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bahsli tezis, gapga singdirilgan kamida uchta qisqa iqtibos, ta’siri bilan tushuntirilgan ikkita vosita, hozirgi zamon va syujetni qayta aytmaslik. Keyingi darsda falsafa va axloq mavzularida munozara qilishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, write a two-hundred-word analysis of a short literary passage, with an arguable thesis, three embedded quotations and two devices explained by their effect. Next time we debate philosophy and ethics.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: qisqa adabiy parcha bo‘yicha ikki yuz so‘zlik tahlil yozing, unda bahsli tezis, uchta singdirilgan iqtibos va ta’siri bilan tushuntirilgan ikkita vosita bo‘lsin. Keyingi safar falsafa va axloq bo‘yicha munozara qilamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan qisqa adabiy parcha (she’r yoki nasrdan bir xatboshi) bo‘yicha 200 so‘zlik tahlil yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bahsli tezis, gapga singdirilgan kamida uchta qisqa iqtibos, ta’siri bilan tushuntirilgan ikkita badiiy vosita, adabiy hozirgi zamon va syujetni qayta aytmaslik; hajm 190–210 so‘z.

quiz.q: Which sentence is an example of a metaphor?
options: Her voice sounded as sweet as honey.
quiz.why_uz: Metafora like/as siz bir narsani boshqa narsa deb ataydi; like yoki as bilan bo‘lsa o‘xshatish bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: A fire station burns down. This is an example of...
quiz.why_uz: Natija kutilganning aksi bo‘lgani uchun bu vaziyat ironiyasi.

quiz.q: Which is a theme statement rather than a topic?
options: The novel is about a politician.
Unchecked ambition destroys what it seeks to win.
quiz.why_uz: G‘oya bitta so‘z emas, mavzu haqidagi to‘liq da’vo.

quiz.q: A locked door appears repeatedly in a novel. It is best described as a...
quiz.why_uz: Takrorlanadigan obraz motiv deyiladi; u ramziy ma’no ham olishi mumkin.

quiz.q: Which sentence is correct in a literary analysis?
options: The poem is describing about loss.
quiz.why_uz: Describe o‘timli fe’l, about olmaydi; tahlilda hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: Choose the best tense: 'In the final scene, Hamlet ___ his revenge.'
quiz.why_uz: Asar ichidagi voqealar adabiy hozirgi zamonda tahlil qilinadi.

quiz.q: 'The cheerful rhyme ___ the grim subject.' Choose the most precise verb.
quiz.why_uz: Undercut quvnoq qofiya ma’yus mavzuga qarshi ishlashini aniq bildiradi.

quiz.q: Which word best describes a mournful, reflective tone about loss?
quiz.why_uz: Elegiac yo‘qotish haqidagi mungli, mulohazakor ohangni bildiradi.

options: This poem is about a tree.
Through the motif of the tree, the poem presents grief as a form of inheritance.
The author wants to say that trees are important.
quiz.why_uz: Kuchli tezis bahsli, aniq va vositani g‘oyaga bog‘laydi.

quiz.q: Where is the main stress in 'ironic'?
quiz.why_uz: Irony da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, ironic da esa ikkinchi bo‘g‘inga ko‘chadi.
